subject: Mutual plan toolkit + evaluation runway — initial MAP GDoc and timeline
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@cynosure.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan toolkit + evaluation runway — initial MAP GDoc and timeline

Hi Erin,

Great to meet last week — thanks again for the demo call. As discussed, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) template and an evaluation checklist to help structure the pilot and speed up approval. The goal is to align stakeholders, agree on success criteria, and lock a 6‑8 week runway to pilot Redwood in a single internal workflow.

I attached an editable Google Doc version of the MAP and a short slide deck that outlines a recommended timeline. Can you review the stakeholder table and the acceptance criteria section and flag any gaps? A couple of specific asks: 
- Confirm which Cynosure team owns data ingress (security contact) and who will be the primary technical lead for integration.
- Approve the success metrics in the doc (page: "Acceptance & Exit Criteria").
- If procurement needs a template SOW or an initial PO estimate, tell me and we’ll loop finance early.

Links / attachments: MAP-toolkit-v1.gdoc (Google Doc), Cynosure-eval-checklist.xlsx, MAP-kickoff-slides.pptx

Proposed next steps:
1) You review and add stakeholders to the doc by EOD Wednesday (11 Aug).
2) We host a 30‑minute kickoff next Friday to align owners and confirm the 6‑8 week run.
3) Redwood will ship a small integration checklist (sample config + API keys guidance) before the kickoff.

If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite for Friday and share an updated GDoc link that captures your edits.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0194 | tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@cynosure.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan toolkit + evaluation runway — initial MAP GDoc and timeline

Hi Tessa — thanks for putting this together. I pasted a short stakeholder list into the doc and added the name of our security contact (Brandon Lee, brandon.lee@cynosure.ai). A few quick notes inline:
- Acceptance criteria: can we add an availability objective (99.5% during business hours) for the pilot? My ops team needs it spelled out.
- Data ingress: Cynosure owns the secure ingestion pipeline but we need a short statement on data retention and purge policies for the pilot.
- PO: procurement asked for a ballpark cost estimate by next Tuesday (12 Aug).

I’m available for a 30‑minute kickoff Friday 13 Aug at 10:00 PT — works for your team?

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Director, Product Ops | Cynosure Systems
E: erin.walsh@cynosure.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@cynosure.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan toolkit + evaluation runway — initial MAP GDoc and timeline

Thanks Erin — great feedback. I updated the GDoc with the availability objective and added a short retention statement (pilot: data retained for 30 days, encrypted at rest; we can extend per policy). I also added a column in the stakeholder table for "Decision authority" so we can see who needs sign‑off.

Erin, I dropped in an estimated band for the pilot run in the doc (range based on three expected throughput profiles). This is intentionally a ballpark to help procurement — we can refine after we run a small ingest test.

Sharing the edited doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2bMAPtoolkit-example (edit access for external collaborators enabled).

Also attached a two‑slide summary I will use in the kickoff ("MAP-kickoff-slides.pptx") and a simple CSV export of the acceptance checklist so your execs can attach it to the vendor evaluation packet.

On the Friday kickoff: 13 Aug 10:00 PT works for me — Tessa/Marissa/Dev, can you confirm?

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
